A familiar little game.

Klondike is the classic seven-column Solitaire.

The goal

Move all 52 cards to the four suit piles at the top. Each starts with an ace and ends with a king, all in the same suit.

On the table

  • Build downward, switching between red and black. A black 7 goes on a red 8.
  • Move one face-up card or a whole face-up run together.
  • Only a king, or a run starting with a king, can fill an empty column.
  • Covered cards turn over when you uncover them. You can also move the top card of a suit pile back to the table.

Draw and play

Tap the face-down deck to draw one card. Only the top discard can be played. When the deck is empty, tap its circular arrow to reuse the discards, as often as you like.

Tap a card, then a highlighted pile. Or drag the card. With a keyboard, use Tab and Enter or Space. Escape clears a selection. Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes a move.

Hint suggests a legal move, not a guaranteed solution. Not every shuffle can be won. Finish game appears when the deck and discard are empty and all remaining cards are face up.

Your game and up to 200 undo steps are saved on this device. The clock pauses when the app is in the background. Clearing browser data removes your save.

Make room for a little play.

Install Solitaire like an app. It opens in its own window and works without an internet connection after the first full visit.

On iPhone or iPad

Open this page in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

On Android

Open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.

Installation needs an HTTPS address, which is a secure website address. A local development address works only on the computer running the app. Wait for "Offline ready" before going offline.
